text: Betsson AB has been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2000. Per its corporate governance report, its three largest shareholders by voting rights are Hamberg Förvaltning AB (18.2% of votes, 3.6% of capital), Lars Kling (12.4% of votes, 2.8% of capital) and Knutsson Holdings AB (12.0% of votes, 4.6% of capital); no state shareholder is identified.

source.name: Betsson AB Corporate Governance Report 2023
source.quote: Betsson has been a listed company since 1996 and has been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2000
